description.value: Design for "New Gas Fires Light Themselves" poster for Gas Light and Coke Company. At center, a white star surrounded by blue and black star-shaped ground; a tiny figure stands on one of the star’s arms with small stars leading from its hand. In the center of the white star is a yellow and blue tulip. Text superimposed over central image, in black: MY NEW / GAS FIRES. Emanating downwards from the "s" in "FIRES": a line of small white stars. Below in black text over a red brush stroke: LIGHT THEMSELVES! In between text and the central image, graphite sketch of the star-shaped figure.

legal.credit: Gift of Mrs. E. McKnight Kauffer
